title: Rope in the Sinkholes, salt in the Sunscar
changes: The Ropewell Lift now stands over the sinkhole in Ropewell's square, its cage going up and down. Ropewell's halls stand on stilts with rope-netted thatch, and there is a rope walk in the east yard and coils of rope by the houses.
Rope gantries with cage baskets stand on the pit rims in Hollowbrook Dells and round the Great Maw.

A caravan halt rests outside Kel Ashar's east gate: a loaded litter under a striped canopy with camels kneeling round it. You can't walk through the canopy. Kel Ashar's biggest houses have wind-catchers, salt is stacked at the oases, and there are salt pans on the Glasswind Flats.
Hamid, the Lodge-Warden, Hesta Coil and Zahra have new things to say about rope, lifts, caravans and salt.
